log.notes_to_self: Strategy: kill every criminal seen daily (11/day) to hit the x2 multiplier (30 deaths in 5 days) and then x4 (40). Put all quick kills in the AFTERNOON so night, home and student routines all fit (55% of people stay in the pool). Timed entries are optional; if used, put them in the evening (2 or fewer busy-block deaths reveal nothing). Watch press pool size. If the pool gets near about 3000, consider skipping victims from a place L seems able to trace (sector, region, age, forum or foreign). National victims are always safe. Day 1: killed all 11 in the afternoon.

Strategy: kill every criminal seen daily (11/day) to reach x2 (30 deaths in 5 days) and then x4 (40). Quick kills go in the AFTERNOON. Night workers, people at home and students are all free then, so 55% of people stay in the pool. The 11th kill is a timed entry, also in the afternoon. Risk: L learns which places I follow once he has 3 successfully traced victims from the same place. With any 3 traceable categories the pool can fall below 1000 (55000 x 0.2 x 0.25 x 0.25 is about 690). So watch the press pool. If it drops sharply after a conference, work out which categories caused the drop (sector 0.2, the others 0.25) and STOP killing victims from those places. National victims are always safe. Above about 5000 it is probably fine to keep killing everything. Day 1: all 11 killed in the afternoon (10 quick, 1 timed in the evening). Day 2: all 11 killed in the afternoon (10 quick, 1 timed).

Strategy: kill every criminal I see each day (11/day). Day 3 brings the 5-day total to 33, so today is x2. From day 4 on it will be 44 or more, so x4. Quick kills go in the AFTERNOON. Night workers, people at home and students are free then, so 55% of people stay in the pool. The 11th kill is a timed entry, also in the afternoon. Day 1 had one timed kill in the evening, which is harmless because L only rules out a routine busy during more than 2 of a day's deaths. Pool was 60000 after day 2, with 5 deaths traced. Risk: L learns which places I follow once he has 3 successfully traced victims from the same place. With any 3 traceable categories the pool can fall below 1000 (55000 x 0.2 x 0.25 x 0.25 is about 690). Watch the press pool. If it drops sharply after a conference, work out which categories caused the drop (sector x0.2, the others x0.25). Then STOP killing victims from those places, or cut back. National victims are always safe. Above about 5000 it is probably fine to keep killing everything. If the pool falls to around 3000 or less, kill only national victims plus victims from places that look untraceable. Days 1, 2 and 3: all 11 killed in the afternoon.

Strategy: kill every criminal I see each day (11/day). Days 1-4 = 44 kills, so from day 4 on every day is x4 as long as I keep killing at least 7 a day. Quick kills go in the AFTERNOON, when night workers, people at home and students are free (55% of people). The 11th kill is a timed entry, also in the afternoon. The pool was 60000 after day 2, with 5 deaths traced. Risk: L learns which places I follow once 3 successfully traced victims come from the same place. With 3 traceable categories the pool can fall below 1000 (55000 x 0.2 x 0.25 x 0.25 is about 690). Watch the press pool. If it drops sharply, work out the cause: sector x0.2, the others x0.25. Then stop killing victims from those places. National victims are always safe. Above about 5000 keep killing everything. At about 3000 or below, kill only national victims and victims from places that look untraceable, keeping at least 8 kills a day if possible for x4. Days 1-4: all 11 killed in the afternoon (day 1 had one timed kill in the evening).
